library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(glmnet)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)






# 5.1. Ready data for LASSO Workflow


# Set file paths
data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

# Import data
patient_info_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "patient_info_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, row.names=1, check.names=F)

# Define nfolds
nfolds <- as.numeric(Parameters["Folds", "Count"])

# Prepare inputs for LASSO
X <- as.matrix(protein_mat)  
y <- patient_info_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"







# 5.2. LASSO Workflow


# Function for a single outer CV fold
lasso_cv_outer_fold <- function(test_fold) {
  set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)
  
  train <- patient_info_with_folds$fold != test_fold
  
  # Fit full lambda path
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE
    )

  




# 5.2a. Select lambda based on LASSO CV


  # Perform cross validated LASSO to pick optimal lambda
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = nfolds
    )

  # Predictions on test fold
  preds <- predict(fit, X[!train, ], type = "response",
    s = cv_fit$lambda.1se)[, 1] %>%
    data.frame(pred = .) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name")

  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  coefs_vec <- coef(fit, s = cv_fit$lambda.1se)[-1, 1]  # remove intercept

  # Keep nonzero coefficients only
  nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]






# 5.2b. Build data frame


  # Build data frame
  nonzero <- data.frame(
    protein = names(nonzero),
    coef = as.numeric(nonzero),
    fold = test_fold
    )

  list(pred = preds, mod = fit, coef = nonzero) 
}






# 5.3. Run LASSO on all folds


# Run LASSO across all folds
lasso_results <- lapply(
  1:max(patient_info_with_folds$fold), 
  lasso_cv_outer_fold)

# Combine predictions and coefficients
lasso_preds <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$pred) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$coef) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Merge SYMBOL-based annotations directly
lasso_fold_coefs <- merge(
  lasso_fold_coefs,
  protein_lookup_table,
  by.x = "protein",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Save outputs
write.csv(lasso_fold_coefs,
          file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
          row.names=F)

# Summary
print(table(lasso_fold_coefs$protein))

all(lasso_fold_coefs$protein %in% 
      protein_lookup_table$SYMBOL)  # Should return TRUE

nrow(lasso_fold_coefs) 

all(rownames(X) == patient_info_with_folds$patient_id) # Should return TRUE






# Alt 5.2. LASSO with fixed protein count per fold


# Set target number of proteins (e.g. 1 or 3)
target_n <- 1

lasso_cv_fixed_n <- function(test_fold) {
  set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)
  
  
  
  
  
  
# Alt 5.2a. Select lambda
  

  train <- patient_info_with_folds$fold != test_fold

  # Fit full lambda path
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  # Cross validated LASSO to pick optimal lambda
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X[train, ], y[train],
    family = "binomial",
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = nfolds
  )

  # Count nonzero coefficients at each lambda
  nz <- apply(fit$beta, 2, function(b) sum(b != 0))

  # Find lambda that selects exactly target_n proteins
  if (any(nz == target_n)) {
    lambda_target <- fit$lambda[which(nz == target_n)[1]]
  } else {
    # Use closest lambda to target_n
    lambda_target <- fit$lambda[which.min(abs(nz - target_n))]
  }

  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  coefs_vec <- coef(fit, s = lambda_target)[-1, 1]
  nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]

  # Trim to top target_n by absolute value
  if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {
    nonzero <- nonzero[order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]]
  }

  # Adjust lambda until target_n reached (safeguard)
  if (length(nonzero) < target_n) {
    lam_idx <- which.min(abs(fit$lambda - lambda_target))
    while (length(nonzero) < target_n && lam_idx < length(fit$lambda)) {
      lam_idx <- lam_idx + 1
      coefs_vec <- coef(fit, s = fit$lambda[lam_idx])[-1, 1]
      nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]
    }
    if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {
      nonzero <- nonzero[order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]]
    }
  }

  # Safeguard
  stopifnot(length(nonzero) == target_n)

  # Predictions
  preds <- predict(fit, X[!train, ], type="response",
    s = lambda_target)[, 1] %>%
    data.frame(pred = .) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name")

  
  
  
  
  
# Alt 5.2b. Build data frame
  
  # Coefs data frame
  nonzero_df <- data.frame(
    protein = names(nonzero),
    coef    = as.numeric(nonzero),
    fold    = test_fold
  )

  list(pred = preds, mod = fit, coef = nonzero_df)
}






# Alt 5.3. Run across all folds


lasso_results_fixed_n <- lapply(
  1:max(patient_info_with_folds$fold),
  lasso_cv_fixed_n
)

# Combine predictions and coefficients
lasso_preds_fixed_n <- lasso_results_fixed_n %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$pred) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n <- lasso_results_fixed_n %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$coef) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n <- merge(
  lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n,
  protein_lookup_table,
  by.x = "protein",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n,
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("lasso_fold_coefs_n", target_n, ".csv")),
  row.names=F)

# Safety check
stopifnot(all(table(lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n$fold) == target_n))

print(table(lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n$protein))






# 5.5 Bar Graph


# lambda.1se
prot_freq <- table(lasso_fold_coefs$protein)
prot_df <- as.data.frame(prot_freq)
colnames(prot_df) <- c("protein", "fold_freq")

# fixed_n
prot_freq_n <- table(lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n$protein)
prot_df_n <- as.data.frame(prot_freq_n)
colnames(prot_df_n) <- c("protein", "fold_freq")

top10coefs        <- lasso_fold_coefs %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(coef), n=10)
top10coefs_n      <- lasso_fold_coefs_fixed_n %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(coef), n=10)




# 5.5a. Protein frequency plots


# lambda.1se
ggplot(
  prot_df %>% filter(fold_freq > 1),
  aes(x = reorder(protein, fold_freq), y = fold_freq)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(title = "Proteins Selected Across >1 Fold (lambda.1se)",
       x = NULL, y = "Number of folds selected") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# target lambda
ggplot(
  prot_df_n %>% filter(fold_freq > 1),
  aes(x = reorder(protein, fold_freq), y = fold_freq)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(title = paste0("Proteins Selected Across >1 Fold (n=", target_n, ")"),
       x = NULL, y = "Number of folds selected") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)




# 5.5b. Top 10 |coef| plots


# lambda.1se
ggplot(
  top10coefs,
  aes(x = coef, y = interaction(protein, fold, sep = " | "))
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#d95f02", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("Fold ", fold)),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white", size = 4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(coef, 3)),
    hjust = ifelse(top10coefs$coef > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
    size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.0, 1.5), breaks = seq(-1.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = sort) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Proteins by |coef| (lambda.1se)",
       x = "Coefficient", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# target lambda
ggplot(
  top10coefs_n,
  aes(x = coef, y = interaction(protein, fold, sep = " | "))
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#d95f02", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("Fold ", fold)),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white", size = 4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(coef, 3)),
    hjust = ifelse(top10coefs_n$coef > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
    size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.0, 1.5), breaks = seq(-1.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = sort) +
  labs(title = paste0("Top 10 Proteins by |coef| (n=", target_n, ")"),
       x = "Coefficient", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
